title: Unrecorded compositions, including one on High Society
summary: Picou has four compositions never recorded, including a high society variation, which bands found too hard.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: One thing I wanted to ask too was this. Uh, is there anything that you have had in your mind that you would like to record, that you have never recorded, that you never had an opportunity to do?
Yes. Yes. Yes. What is that? Yes. I got four, I got four numbers by all composition. And I never had the opportunity of recording them.
Are they written down? Yes. Mm-hmm.
I tried it with Papa Celeste. Uh-huh. But I never did succeed yet. Uh-huh. I got one number. It's based on high society. Uh-huh. The variation with the clarinet and all that.
Nobody's had a chance to hear it, though. Uh-huh.

They tried it and that's all. They didn't like it. Too hard to learn, maybe. Yes, yes. Oh, yes, very hard. Maybe Bill could get you praying that sometimes. Why, you see? They got a gang of fellows here, come with it, give it up. You know? That's not the right type of a band to play those strings here. They have to be able to read all those. I say, can you all follow me? They say, hell no. Oh, no. I say, come on. Oh, God. No. No. Oh, God. No. Well, someday maybe you'll get to play those. You have them arranged for orchestra or just have the piano parts. How do you have it written out? Just with the piano and the clarinet or how? No, the whole band. The whole band. The whole band. The whole orchestration of it. Yes. Is there a hospital? No. We'd like to see those too sometime. In nice, sometimes, get a band together and play those. Yes. Are there any other pieces that you wrote that are played much? That's what I've thought about.
I mean, others that people do play.
Any other thing besides, like the high society, can you think of some others that you wrote?
Do you remember the titles of any of those?

Sure. I've got them all. No. One thing I was going to ask you Alfonso, is that you have written a lot of songs, and you have written a lot of songs. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. It should be good man. No no.
